Abstract: A Lewis acid-catalyzed tricyclization of
yne-allenones with 1-alkynylnaphthalen-2-ols has
been developed, and used to produce a wide range
of rotationally hindered tribenzo[a,c,j]xanthenes
with generally good yields and stereoselectivity .
This process involves a complex [2 + 2] cyclo-
addition relay and [4 + 2] cyclization cascade,
enabling scission/recombination of C � C triple
bonds to access unprecedented hexaheterocyclic
architectures. The reaction also features good
compatibility with different types of substituents,
triple annulation cascade and the eff icient control of
regio- and stereochemistry .
Keywords: Alkynes; Oxygen heterocycles; Regiose-
lectivity; Annulation; Multicomponent reactions
Functional oxa-heterocycles, due to their prevalence in
substantial auxiliaries,
[1]
building blocks,
[2]
biological
substances
[3]
and clinical drugs,
[4]
are always in great
demand in organic synthesis, chemical biology , and
material science as well as medicinal chemistry .
[5]
Consequently , the development of eff icient and prac-
tical synthetic methodologies for the assembly of
heterocycles with challenging oxa-skeletons such as
xanthenes and stereochemistry becomes one of impor-
tant targets.
[6]
Among the enormous methods, multiple
cyclization strategy is an attractive approach and has
been widely applied for the generation of structurally
complex oxygen-containing molecules because of their
inherent characteristics of annulation cascade, step-
and atom-economy and sustainability as well as
conver gence.
[7]
Cycloaddition reactions have evolved into eff ective
technique to assemble cyclic rings in the or ganic
community .
[8]
Over the past decades, various reaction
types, including [2 + 1],
[9]
[2 + 2],
[10]
[3 + 2],
[1 1]
[4 +
2],
[12]
and [4 + 4]
[13]
cycloaddition and so on,
[14]
have
been well-developed by means of thermal, or gano-
catalytic, photoinduced or/and transition metal-cata-
lyzed strategies. In contrast, standing for a new mode
of cycloaddition reaction, double [2 + 2] cycloaddition
relay remains elusive and constitutes a much more
challenging task, because of their cycloaddition part-
ners must match their frontier molecular orbitals. V ery
recently , we reported a first catalytic double [2 + 2]
cycloaddition relay between yne-allenones and unac-
tivated alkenes or alkynes, leading to the formation of
functionalized phenanthren-9-ols through the C � C
triple bond breaking/rearranging (Scheme 1a).
[15]
How-
ever , the reaction has suff ered from a major restriction
that the electron-neutral internal arylated alkynes such
as 1,2-diphenylethyne remained unreactive in this
transformation. W e analyzed that the frontier molecular
orbital of such internal alkyne did not match that of in-
situ-generated activated alkene from yne-allenones,
thus requiring the higher electron density of the
internal alkynes. On the other hand, 1-alkynyl naph-
thalen-2-ols serve as electron-rich internal alkynes
showed a high reactivity profile, enabling their
intermolecular [2 + 2] cycloaddition reactions with
electron-eff icient alkenes to construct oxa-
heterocycles.
[15]
Inspired by these successful trans-

T o gain mechanistic insight into this tricyclization,
several control experiments were conducted. The
reaction of 1 a with 2-(phenylethynyl)phenol 4 did not

materials were recovered (Scheme 4a). Similarly , O-

1 a as well (Scheme 4b). These observations suggested
that naphthol ring linked by the alkynyl unit is crucial
for the current tricyclization.

greater steric hindrance (path b).
In summary , we have developed a novel Lewis
acid-catalyzed tricyclization cascade involving the [2 +
2] cycloaddition relay , enabling the scission/recombi-
nation of the C � C triple bonds to stereoselectively
generate hitherto unreported hexacyclic tribenzo[a,c,j]
xanthenes bearing a rotationally hindered chiral axis
with generally good yields. The reaction progress is
considered to proceed through a double [2 + 2] cyclo-
addition relay , C � C triple bond cleavage and oxa-
cyclization sequence. The three-component tricycliza-
tion favors the eff icient control of regio- and stereo-
chemistry , good compatibility with diff erent types of
substituents, high atom utilization as well as triple
annulation cascade. Further investigation and applica-
